from pathlib import Path
folder=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u017/system/state/workspace/programs')
folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != grid[0][0]]
    if not points:
        return out
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points)
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        if out[r0][c] == grid[0][0]:
            out[r0][c] = 2
        if out[r1][c] == grid[0][0]:
            out[r1][c] = 2
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        if out[r][c0] == grid[0][0]:
            out[r][c0] = 2
        if out[r][c1] == grid[0][0]:
            out[r][c1] = 2
    return out
'''
p=folder/'task-8b589275.py'
p.write_text(code)
ns={}
exec(code,ns)
